movements.halakhic_position: Strict immutability of Halakha across all details; literal divine revelation of Written and Oral Torah at Sinai.
movements.view_of_modernity: Cultural insulation, rejection of secular values, prioritization of full-time Yeshiva study (Torato Umanuto).
sub_branches: Lithuanian / Yeshivish (Misnagdim: rigorous analytical Talmudic study)
movements.messiah_position: Awaits literal personal human King Messiah from Davidic line.

movements.halakhic_position: Strict fidelity to Shulchan Aruch and traditional poskim; belief in Torah Mi-Sinai.
movements.view_of_modernity: Torah U'Madda (Torah and secular knowledge/sciences integrated); active civic, professional, and military engagement.
movements.attitude_to_israel: Strong Religious Zionism (viewing modern Israel as Reshit Tzemichat Ge'ulateinu — first flowering of our redemption).

movements.halakhic_position: Halakha is binding and normative, but historically developmental and evolving to address modern ethics and scientific realities.

features: Egalitarian minyanim and ordination of women and LGBTQ+ rabbis

movements.halakhic_position: Halakha is non-binding counsel; autonomous individual moral conscience is supreme.

movements.halakhic_position: Non-binding 'folkways'; Judaism is an evolving religious civilization (Mordecai Kaplan).
movements.god_concept: Naturalistic religious humanism (God as the cosmic process that fosters human fulfillment).

movements.halakhic_position: Rejects the Oral Torah, Talmud, and rabbinic authority entirely.
movements.source_authority: Direct autonomous interpretation of the Hebrew Tanakh using grammatical-contextual analysis (Peshuto shel Mikra).

movements.identity_basis: Jewish peoplehood, national history, Hebrew literature, cultural heritage, and shared destiny without adherence to divine commandments or theological dogma.
